[SKU-V03 / VENDOR / SAP EWM]

SAP EWM cost

SAP EWM is sold three ways: embedded EWM inside S/4HANA, decentralized EWM as a standalone, and RISE with SAP as a cloud-bundled subscription. All three are quote-only with 17-22%/yr maintenance on perpetual.

Quote onlyENTERPRISE / saas / on-prem / hybridsource ->
[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Tiered enterprise licensing - perpetual + maintenance (17-22%/yr) or RISE/cloud subscription; quote only[s-03].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Edition: embedded vs decentralized vs RISE-bundled.
  • User type: Professional vs Functional vs Limited Professional, each with different per-user list.
  • Industry add-ons (RFID, Yard, Quality Management) priced separately.
  • RISE bundling discounts EWM against perpetual list but ties compute to SAP.
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

SAP continues pushing EWM customers off ECC/Business Suite 7 toward S/4HANA Cloud and RISE/GROW with SAP bundles ahead of 2027 mainstream-maintenance end. Cloud-only EWM editions now the default path.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • Existing S/4HANA shop where the IT mandate is one ERP vendor end-to-end.
  • Manufacturer running SAP MM/PP wanting tight master-data alignment.
  • Global enterprise with country-tax and customs requirements EWM handles natively.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

Embedded vs decentralized EWM?

Embedded EWM ships inside S/4HANA and shares the same database. Decentralized EWM runs as a separate stack with its own DB and is required for high-throughput DCs or non-SAP ERP backbones.

Does RISE change the EWM cost?

Yes. RISE bundles compute, S/4HANA, and EWM into one subscription. The discount stack changes the perpetual-vs-cloud break-even.

When NOT to use EWM?

When you want best-of-breed WMS features (slotting, robotics orchestration, omnichannel store fulfillment) that EWM does less well than Manhattan or Blue Yonder. Bolt a best-of-breed on top via SAP-certified middleware.
